name: SF Behavioral Health Access Line
description: San Francisco's 24/7 behavioral health access line gives information about mental health and substance use services and helps people access and navigate care. No referral is needed.
fullDescription: San Francisco's 24/7 behavioral health access line gives information about mental health and substance use services and helps people access and navigate care. No referral is needed.
whatTheyOffer:
- Information about SF mental health and substance use services
- Help accessing and navigating care, including benefits enrollment
- Referrals to mental health and substance use treatment
- Drop-in help at the Behavioral Health Access Center (1380 Howard Street)
howToGetIt: Call 415-255-3737 or toll-free 888-246-3333 anytime (TTY 1-888-484-7200). Or drop in at the Behavioral Health Access Center, 1380 Howard Street, 1st Floor (Mon-Fri 8am-7pm, weekends 9am-4pm). For a mental health crisis, call Comprehensive Crisis at 628-217-7000 or 988.
keywords: SF Behavioral Health, access line, Behavioral Health Access Center, BHAC, mental health referral, substance use treatment, benefits enrollment
